events.title: Orlando Solar Bears vs. Greenville Swamp Rabbits
events.blurb: Orlando's ECHL hockey team hosts Greenville on Black Friday night downtown. It's Women in Hockey Night.
events.blurbEs: El equipo de hockey de la ECHL de Orlando recibe a Greenville la noche del Black Friday en el centro. Es la Women in Hockey Night.

events.title: FusionFest
events.blurb: A free two-day festival celebrating the cultures that make up Central Florida, with global food, a main stage of music and dance, and a family village. Leashed, well-behaved pets are welcome.
events.blurbEs: Un festival gratuito de dos días que celebra las culturas de la Florida Central, con comida del mundo, un escenario principal de música y danza, y una zona familiar. Se admiten mascotas con correa y bien portadas.

events.title: Morse Museum Thanksgiving Weekend Celebration
events.venue: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum of American Art
events.addr: 445 N Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
events.blurb: The Tiffany glass museum opens free all weekend, with live music Friday evening from 5 to 8 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El museo de vidrio Tiffany abre gratis todo el fin de semana, con música en vivo el viernes de 5 a 8 p.m.

events.title: A Christmas Carol
events.venue: Orlando Shakespeare Theater, Lowndes Shakespeare Center
events.blurb: Orlando Shakes returns to its renovated Loch Haven Park home with Dickens' holiday ghost story, running through Dec. 24.
events.blurbEs: Orlando Shakes regresa a su sede renovada en Loch Haven Park con el cuento navideño de fantasmas de Dickens, en cartelera hasta el 24 de diciembre.

events.title: Home for the Holidays: Michael James Scott's A Fierce Holiday
events.blurb: Broadway's Michael James Scott joins the Orlando Philharmonic for a holiday pops program, with a matinee and an evening show.
events.blurbEs: Michael James Scott, de Broadway, se une a la Orlando Philharmonic en un concierto navideño, con función de tarde y de noche.

events.title: Dazzling Nights at Harry P. Leu Gardens
events.blurb: An after-dark walk through the botanical garden lit with holiday light displays.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo nocturno por el jardín botánico iluminado con instalaciones de luces navideñas.

events.title: Frontyard Holiday Festival
events.venue: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
events.blurb: The Dr. Phillips Center's free holiday festival on its front lawn opens Friday and runs through Dec. 31, with Sunday movie nights.
events.blurbEs: El festival navideño gratuito en el jardín delantero del Dr. Phillips Center abre el viernes y sigue hasta el 31 de diciembre, con noches de cine los domingos.

events.title: Amazing Silent Discos: Throwback Party
events.blurb: Headphones on for a throwback-hits silent disco inside the Orlando Science Center on Saturday night.
events.blurbEs: Ponte los audífonos para una silent disco de éxitos de antes dentro del Orlando Science Center el sábado por la noche.
